reference.kind: native Motif control in the Theme Lab reference screenshot; not a VM capture
reference.interpreted_rule: Free-standing up/down triangles on the field surface; consistent upper-left light and lower-right shadow; no raised square panel around each glyph.

change.summary: Removed raised square panels from GTK2 spin steppers. Added independent 13px spin-arrow geometry while leaving the shared GTK2 scrollbar arrow metric at 11px. Both glyphs and flat panels resolve through the selected KDE View and Window relief roles; no final RGB values were added to the product code.

validation.native_matrix: 24 GTK2 scenes passed: DomainOS, BreezeLight, BreezeDark and TestYellow; normal, backdrop and disabled; coupled and separate previews.
validation.surface_palette: The field and flat stepper surface matched the selected effective View role in all 24 scenes.
validation.motif_masks: Up and down 13x13 glyph masks each matched the Motif sample in all 169/169 normalized face/light/shadow pixels.
validation.interaction: In the DomainOS scene, mouse and keyboard stepping, numeric commit, Undo/Redo and clipboard shortcuts passed. Both + and - steppers changed relief while held, matched their generated pressed mask, and returned pixel-identically to normal on release.
validation.py_compile: passed for the GTK2 spin adapter, native probe and Motif comparison test.
validation.git_diff_check: passed for scoped source, test and queue paths.

limits: The 13px glyph metric is measured in the local native Motif Theme Lab sample, not the Domain/OS SR10.4 VM; this does not prove historical VUE sizing.
The Theme Lab UI does not yet expose a persistent per-glyph spin metric; 13px is the adapter default and can be overridden in a recipe programmatically.
This closes only the isolated GTK2 spin visual/interaction step. The remaining GTK2 control families, public/product integration, historical per-control VM comparisons and human approval remain open.
The personal GTK2 session and XChat were not modified.
